title: BEACON: Bridging Multimodal Semantics and Asynchronous Propagation for Cloud System Anomaly Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.27542v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern large-scale cloud systems continuously generate massive and multimodal observability data, such as time-series metrics, log records, and system dependency graphs, which reflect the health state of the system. To ensure reliable cloud system operation, anomaly detection models identify abnormal states by analyzing these multimodal observations. However, existing approaches rely on simple fusion strategies and graph learning, ignoring the semantic gap among modalities and the asynchronous spatio-temporal dependencies across system instances over time. translated_title: BEACON：面向云系统异常检测的多模态语义与异步传播桥接框架
translated_abstract: 现代大规模云系统持续产生海量的多模态可观测性数据，例如时间序列指标、日志记录和系统依赖图，这些数据反映了系统的健康状态。为确保云系统的可靠运行，异常检测模型通过分析这些多模态观测数据来识别异常状态。然而，现有方法依赖于简单的融合策略和图学习，忽略了模态之间的语义鸿沟以及系统实例随时间变化的异步时空依赖关系。为此，我们提出了BEACON，一个面向云系统异常检测、用于桥接多模态语义与异步传播的框架。具体而言，我们引入了动态可解释多模态聚合器，该聚合器利用信息瓶颈机制压缩来自指标的语义和时间动态信息，并将其与日志在共享空间中对齐。
tldr: 提出了BEACON框架，通过基于信息瓶颈机制的动态可解释多模态聚合器弥合多模态数据间的语义鸿沟，并建模系统实例间的异步时空依赖关系，从而提升云系统异常检测的准确性。
en_tdlr: BEACON is proposed as a cloud system anomaly detection framework that bridges the semantic gap across multimodal data via a dynamic interpretable multimodal aggregator with an information-bottleneck mechanism, while modeling asynchronous spatio-temporal dependencies among system instances to improve detection accuracy.
